name: Key Ware Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Key Ware Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, processing, and distribution of printed circuit board materials in Taiwan, Mainland China, and Thailand. It provides drilling products for high aspect radio with coating bit, backdrilling (counterboring), predrilling and positioning drilling, slot bit, ABF, HDI and automobile application, BGA, FPCB and RF, coating tool, and CVD diamond coating applications; as well as series of RCF, RCB, LCF, RCT, routers dimensions, coating tools, and CVD diamond coating. The company also offers electroplating solutions, dry films, drill bits, and copper foil substrates. In addition, it provides mechanical equipment, drilling and hand tools,…
